svg.title: Two apps, one archive
svg.desc: Paperless Sync writes every document of Paperless-ngx as a file of the archive account paperless, with the marker of the document in its name, such as invoice [P412].pdf. The archive account shares its archive read-only with jamie. When jamie searches, Paperless Unified Search asks Paperless-ngx, finds the file of document 412 by its marker, and shows jamie the document because jamie can open that file; the result opens the file in Nextcloud.
